The sheet marks multi-EPC dispensing positive; the platform refuses it — "Dispense event must contain exactly 1 EPC, got 3". That is defensible: a dispense is recorded against one prescription line, so one event per pack keeps it attributable. The case now asserts the refusal, that the refused batch did not partially apply, and that one-per-request still works. Worth confirming with the PO that one-per-request is intended rather than a limit.
